items.name: Broken radio
items.depiction: Cream portable field radio with charcoal grille, bent antenna and exposed disconnected cable socket; teal corner guards.
items.distinction: Same casing as Radio; damage is visible without a floating warning symbol.

items.name: Cable
items.depiction: Loose coil of thick charcoal insulated cable with two chunky metal connector ends.
items.distinction: A flexible electrical cable, distinct from rope and hose.

items.name: Solar panel
items.depiction: Single dark blue photovoltaic panel in a cream folding frame with two supporting legs.
items.distinction: Panel alone; no battery or radio fitted.

items.name: Battery
items.depiction: Compact rectangular cream battery case with charcoal handle, two terminals and restrained yellow charge strip.
items.distinction: Solid energy-storage case, distinct from a radio with grille and aerial.

items.name: Lamp
items.depiction: Unlit portable cream worklight with round glass lens, charcoal carry handle and short stand.
items.distinction: Basic lamp; no battery case, solar panel or reflector dish.

items.name: Reflective foil
items.depiction: Loosely folded thin reflective silver foil with crinkled corners and one partly unfurled sheet.
items.distinction: Thin flexible foil rather than thick quilted insulation.

items.name: Support frame
items.depiction: Bare broad cream tubular chassis frame with cross-braces and four empty wheel mounting lugs.
items.distinction: Open structural skeleton; no wheels, motor or cabin.

items.name: Tripod
items.depiction: Three-legged folded-metal equipment tripod standing open, with a simple mounting head.
items.distinction: Empty support; no camera, lamp or telescope attached.

items.name: Toolkit
items.depiction: Open low teal field-tool case showing a wrench, screwdriver, pliers and neatly retained tools.
items.distinction: General repair tools rather than patch fabric and sealant.

items.name: Radio
items.depiction: Repaired cream portable radio, straight aerial, charcoal speaker grille and intact cable connection.
items.distinction: Retain Broken radio casing; visibly restored connection and aerial.

items.name: Solar radio
items.depiction: Same portable radio connected by a short cable to a compact dark photovoltaic leaf and cream battery pack.
items.distinction: Radio grille and aerial remain prominent; external power distinguishes the upgrade.

items.name: Solar lamp
items.depiction: Same round portable worklight illuminated, connected to a compact blue photovoltaic leaf and cream battery pack.
items.distinction: Lamp lens remains prominent; solar supply differs from Lantern.

items.name: Reflector
items.depiction: Broad shallow reflective silver dish stretched across a cream open support frame, without a lamp.
items.distinction: Reflecting surface alone; no emitting bulb.

items.name: Lantern
items.depiction: Round worklight on its attached cream battery base, warm glowing lens and charcoal carrying handle.
items.distinction: Battery-powered lamp without solar leaf or large reflector.

items.name: Signal lamp
items.depiction: Battery lantern nested at the centre of a wide silver reflector dish, warm bright lens visible.
items.distinction: Reflector now carries the lamp; no tall tripod.

items.name: Signal beacon
items.depiction: Wide silver signal reflector with warm lamp mounted securely on a tall three-legged field tripod.
items.distinction: Complete tall signalling assembly, distinct from handheld lamps.

items.name: Solar charger
items.depiction: Blue photovoltaic panel with cream frame, clearly connected to a substantial cream battery box at its foot.
items.distinction: Panel and battery form one connected unit.

items.name: Heater
items.depiction: Squat cream electric heater with protective charcoal grille, visible warm orange coils and stout feet.
items.distinction: Heat grille and coils distinguish it from radios and power supplies.

items.name: Habitat fabric
items.depiction: Thick rolled ivory pressure fabric with teal inner lining and one broad folded edge.
items.distinction: Flexible fabric roll, not quilted metallic insulation.

items.name: Sealant
items.depiction: Cream sealant cartridge with long narrow application nozzle and a teal band.
items.distinction: Application nozzle prevents confusion with drinking bottles.

items.name: Seam roller
items.depiction: Small steel seam roller with a teal cylindrical wheel and short charcoal handgrip.
items.distinction: Compact pressure tool with one wheel, not a paint roller.

items.name: Tie downs
items.depiction: Neat bundle of brick-red tension cords with three silver ground stakes and visible fastening loops.
items.distinction: Tension cords and stakes rather than electrical connectors.

items.name: Hatch frame
items.depiction: Thick oval cream hatch ring standing on a low sill, with teal latches and an empty central opening.
items.distinction: Empty structural frame rather than a closed door.

items.name: Insulating blanket
items.depiction: Folded quilted silver thermal blanket with thick ivory insulation layers and charcoal retaining straps.
items.distinction: Thick insulating layers distinguish it from Reflective foil.

items.name: Patch supplies
items.depiction: Small open teal pouch containing ivory fabric patches, a sealant cartridge and a short repair strip.
items.distinction: The fabric and sealant from the recipe remain recognizable.

items.name: Sealed panel
items.depiction: Broad rectangular ivory habitat-fabric panel with teal underside visible at one folded corner and a neat sealed seam.
items.distinction: A prepared flexible panel, before installation into a hatch frame.

items.name: Vestibule
items.depiction: Small ivory arched entrance vestibule with cream oval hatch frame and teal inner lining, unanchored and without outer insulation.
items.distinction: Stable silhouette retained through secured, wrapped and insulated states.

items.name: Secured vestibule
items.depiction: Same arched ivory vestibule with brick-red guy lines stretched to metal ground stakes; outer fabric remains unwrapped.
items.distinction: Visible tie-downs distinguish securing from thermal wrapping.

items.name: Wrapped vestibule
items.depiction: Same arched vestibule with quilted silver insulation around its roof and sidewalls, without guy lines or stakes.
items.distinction: Insulated but visibly not tied down.

items.name: Insulated vestibule
items.depiction: Same arched vestibule wearing quilted silver insulation, with brick-red guy lines and stakes securing it.
items.distinction: Both wrapping and anchors remain visible.

items.name: Dirty water
items.depiction: Clear robust cream-capped water vessel containing slightly cloudy meltwater with a few visible sediment particles.
items.distinction: Same vessel as Water; cloudiness is a limited cue, not proof of safety.

items.name: Water filter
items.depiction: Cream cylindrical mission filter with teal collars, transparent filter chamber and two short hose connectors.
items.distinction: Plumbed filter appliance, not a water bottle.

items.name: Seeds
items.depiction: Small open ivory seed packet with a few dark oblong seeds lying beside it and a tiny plant motif.
items.distinction: Seeds alone, dry and without planting medium.

items.name: Planting tray
items.depiction: Empty shallow rectangular charcoal planting tray with cream rim and visible square cells.
items.distinction: Same tray maintained throughout the seedling sequence.

items.name: Clear cover
items.depiction: Transparent rectangular domed propagator lid with a small teal vent and clearly visible rim.
items.distinction: Empty cover alone, not a filled propagator.

items.name: Water
items.depiction: Same robust clear cream-capped vessel containing clear water.
items.distinction: Retain Dirty water vessel; exact treatment history uses the name and context.

items.name: Seed tray
items.depiction: Same charcoal planting tray filled with pale prepared substrate and visibly scattered dark seeds.
items.distinction: Unwatered uncovered tray; no sprouts.

items.name: Wet seeds
items.depiction: Small shallow transparent dish holding dark seeds with visible water droplets and a little clear water.
items.distinction: Loose wetted seeds before transfer into the planting tray.

items.name: Watered seed tray
items.depiction: Same seeded charcoal tray with darker moist substrate and a few restrained water highlights.
items.distinction: Moist uncovered tray; no sprouting or lid.

items.name: Covered seed tray
items.depiction: Same seeded tray beneath a clear domed cover, pale substrate visible through the lid.
items.distinction: Covered yet unwatered; the lid is the strongest visible distinction.

items.name: Watered covered tray
items.depiction: Same seeded tray beneath a clear vented dome, dark moist substrate and faint condensation visible.
items.distinction: Watered and covered, but no green shoots yet.

items.name: Sprouted tray
items.depiction: Same uncovered charcoal planting tray with several small fresh green seedlings emerging from moist cells.
items.distinction: Living shoots and absence of dome distinguish this state.

items.name: Propagator
items.depiction: Same tray of small green seedlings under a clear vented dome with teal rim detail.
items.distinction: Young plants remain clearly visible beneath the protective cover.

items.name: Wheels
items.depiction: Pair of broad dark rover wheels with pronounced tread and exposed metal hubs.
items.distinction: Standalone wheel set without chassis or motor.

items.name: Drive motor
items.depiction: Compact cylindrical metal electric drive motor with mustard housing cap and projecting drive shaft.
items.distinction: Motor alone, without electronic controller.

items.name: Motor controller
items.depiction: Flat cream finned controller module with mustard connector strip and a short cable socket bank.
items.distinction: Electronic module rather than a rotating motor.

items.name: Seat harness
items.depiction: Dark fabric five-point safety harness with mustard shoulder accents and a central metal buckle.
items.distinction: Harness only; no seat or vehicle.

items.name: Dish antenna
items.depiction: Shallow cream communications dish on a short articulated bracket with a central feed horn.
items.distinction: Standalone dish distinct from powered radios and relay antenna mast.

items.name: Camera
items.depiction: Compact cream field camera with cobalt grip, a prominent black lens and side shutter control.
items.distinction: Handheld camera without tripod or long telescope tube.

items.name: Regional map navchip
items.depiction: Rugged cream navigation cartridge with a blue edge and a small inset screen showing a broad region contour map.
items.distinction: Same cartridge form as Outcrop and Crew navchips; distinct map view.

items.name: Lens
items.depiction: Single round optical lens in a slim black metal retaining ring, with a restrained cool glass reflection.
items.distinction: Glass optic alone, distinct from a seal or washer.

items.name: Optical tube
items.depiction: Long hollow cream telescope tube with dark open ends and a cobalt mounting collar.
items.distinction: Empty tube, without glass lens or supporting tripod.

items.name: Drive unit
items.depiction: Metal electric drive motor bolted to its compact finned controller, with a short connected cable.
items.distinction: Both motor shaft and controller body visible.

items.name: Field camera
items.depiction: Cream and cobalt field camera securely mounted on a slim open metal tripod.
items.distinction: Camera lens remains distinct from longer telescope assemblies.

items.name: Outcrop approach view
items.depiction: Physical glossy photograph with a narrow ivory border showing an ice outcrop, nearby ridge and approach landmarks.
items.distinction: Photographic terrain observation, not a plotted route map.

items.name: Outcrop navchip
items.depiction: Same blue-edged navigation cartridge with a small screen showing a route line leading to an ice outcrop symbol.
items.distinction: Same hardware as regional navchip; route content provides the changed state.

items.name: Telescope
items.depiction: Long cream optical telescope with glass front lens, dark eyepiece and cobalt mounting collar, no tripod.
items.distinction: Completed optics, distinct from the empty Optical tube.

items.name: Field telescope
items.depiction: Long cream telescope with cobalt collar mounted on an open three-legged metal tripod.
items.distinction: Long optical tube and eyepiece, no camera attached.

items.name: Telescope camera
items.depiction: Same mounted telescope with the cream camera coupled visibly to the rear eyepiece.
items.distinction: Camera attachment remains legible in the composite.

items.name: Sample scoop
items.depiction: Small stainless sampling scoop with a broad shallow bowl and cobalt handle.
items.distinction: Scoop rather than coring tube or drill.

items.name: Transparent jar
items.depiction: Empty clear squat sample jar with a cobalt screw lid placed beside its open mouth.
items.distinction: Jar is visibly empty and available for filling.

items.name: Core tube
items.depiction: Long narrow hollow stainless sampling tube with a cobalt collar and open cutting end.
items.distinction: Tubular sampler without a collected core inside.

items.name: Sample labels
items.depiction: Short fan of ivory specimen tags with cobalt attachment holes and restrained ruled fields.
items.distinction: Loose labels, not a scientific result or already labelled jar.

items.name: Windowed box
items.depiction: Cream rectangular laboratory enclosure with a broad clear front window and two blank circular glove-port openings.
items.distinction: Empty handling enclosure before gloves are installed.

items.name: Glove ports
items.depiction: Pair of black protective glove sleeves mounted in circular cobalt retaining rings.
items.distinction: Two fitted glove assemblies, not loose outdoor gloves.

items.name: Ice sample
items.depiction: Irregular pale translucent ice fragment with a few frosted faces and blue-white internal highlights.
items.distinction: Loose ice sample, not reddish rock or cut cylindrical core.

items.name: Sealed ice sample
items.depiction: Clear squat jar holding a pale ice fragment, tightly closed with a cobalt lid and no specimen label.
items.distinction: Same jar identity as Transparent jar, now sealed and filled.

items.name: Catalogued ice sample
items.depiction: Same sealed cobalt-lidded ice jar with a prominent ivory specimen tag attached below its neck.
items.distinction: Physical tag distinguishes the catalogued specimen from the sealed one.

items.name: Ice photograph
items.depiction: Glossy photograph with narrow ivory border depicting the cobalt-lidded jar and its pale ice sample.
items.distinction: A photograph of the specimen, rather than the specimen itself.

items.name: Ice core
items.depiction: Long translucent cylindrical ice core with readable faint horizontal layers and frosted ends.
items.distinction: Long cylindrical sample rather than an irregular ice fragment.

items.name: Core layer photograph
items.depiction: Physical photograph of a vertical translucent ice core, its horizontal layers clearly visible within the image.
items.distinction: Recorded image with paper border, not a loose ice core.

items.name: Cliff photograph
items.depiction: Physical photograph showing a Martian cliff face with broad horizontal rock layers.
items.distinction: Landscape layers rather than a close-up sample or route diagram.

items.name: Glovebox
items.depiction: Cream windowed handling enclosure with two black glove sleeves fitted through cobalt rings; chamber unlit.
items.distinction: Gloves installed, without the warm internal worklight.

items.name: Illuminated glovebox
items.depiction: Same cream and cobalt glovebox with a warm interior worklight illuminating the enclosed work surface and black glove sleeves.
items.distinction: Keep enclosure unchanged; internal illumination is the upgrade.

items.name: Sensor mast
items.depiction: Tall slim cream weather mast with instrument pods and an empty top fitting for a vane.
items.distinction: Mast alone, without wind vane, logger or solar power.

items.name: Wind vane
items.depiction: Metal arrow-shaped wind vane on a small spindle, with three shallow cup elements and cobalt hub.
items.distinction: Detached wind-sensing fitting.

items.name: Sensor logger
items.depiction: Cream weather-data recorder with a blue display showing a simple time trace and two sensor sockets.
items.distinction: Recorder module; no independent mast or power panel.

items.name: Filter mesh
items.depiction: Rectangular charcoal mesh sheet with a clearly open fine woven structure and folded corner.
items.distinction: Air-permeable mesh, distinct from solid insulating fabric.

items.name: Vented enclosure
items.depiction: Empty cream protective electronics box with side ventilation louvers and an open front cover.
items.distinction: Empty enclosure before mesh or controller installation.

items.name: Weather record
items.depiction: Handheld cream logger display with an intelligible dust and wind trace and a broad quieter interval marked on the graph.
items.distinction: An observed time record, not a forecast certificate.

items.name: Dust screen
items.depiction: Same cream vented enclosure with dark filter mesh fitted over its air openings, still empty inside.
items.distinction: Filtered enclosure before the controller is protected inside it.

items.name: Protected controller
items.depiction: Finned controller mounted inside the cream vented enclosure, dark mesh visible across the ventilation openings.
items.distinction: Controller and protective enclosure remain visible together.

items.name: Relay transceiver
items.depiction: Cream relay transceiver box with cobalt handles, radio ports and open small fuse access hatch.
items.distinction: Repairable transceiver without antenna or external powerpack.

items.name: Spare fuse
items.depiction: Single stout glass cartridge fuse with silver end caps and a visible internal conductor.
items.distinction: Small replaceable electrical part, not an energy cell.

items.name: Directional antenna
items.depiction: Narrow directional array of parallel metal elements on a cream boom and cobalt mounting foot.
items.distinction: Distinct silhouette from the round Dish antenna.

items.name: Relay powerpack
items.depiction: Cream rugged rectangular powerpack with cobalt carry handle, capped terminals and a short connector lead.
items.distinction: Dedicated relay pack; no aerial or speaker grille.

items.name: Distress recording
items.depiction: Small cream audio recorder with cobalt edge, visible speaker slots and an inset waveform display.
items.distinction: A received audio message, not a map or navigation cartridge.

items.name: Crew navchip
items.depiction: Same blue-edged navigation cartridge with a route line ending at a small paired-person marker beside a crawler silhouette.
items.distinction: Route destination changes while cartridge identity remains stable.

items.name: Recovery rope
items.depiction: Heavy loosely coiled brick-red recovery rope with a thick braided texture and looped ends.
items.distinction: Thicker than tie-down cords; no metal tow eye fitted yet.

items.name: Tow eye
items.depiction: Heavy forged steel towing eye with a thick circular opening and short threaded stem.
items.distinction: Load-bearing tow fitting, not an optical lens.

items.name: Spare drive
items.depiction: Bulky mustard and metal crawler drive unit with a capped output shaft and closed service panel.
items.distinction: Stored drive module before servicing and coupling.

items.name: Drive coupling
items.depiction: Short heavy steel flexible shaft coupling with two flanged ends and a black central sleeve.
items.distinction: Mechanical joining part, not a complete motor.

items.name: Disabled crawler
items.depiction: Cream tracked expedition crawler with enclosed cabin, mustard panels and open damaged drive access on one side.
items.distinction: Same vehicle silhouette throughout recovery; visible drive fault, no cartoon crash marks.

items.name: Serviced drive
items.depiction: Same mustard crawler drive unit with open inspection cover showing restored clean internal connection and exposed output shaft.
items.distinction: Serviced module still lacks the external coupling.

items.name: Replacement drive
items.depiction: Same restored crawler drive module with the short steel flanged coupling attached to its output shaft.
items.distinction: Coupling is a clear added structure.

items.name: Tow line
items.depiction: Heavy brick-red recovery rope with a substantial steel towing eye securely fitted at one end.
items.distinction: Joined towing assembly distinct from loose Recovery rope.

items.name: Recovered crawler
items.depiction: Same cream tracked crawler with its disabled drive panel still visible, thick brick-red towing line attached to the front tow point.
items.distinction: Recovery by towing does not imply the drive is repaired.

items.name: Service shelter · torn seam
items.depiction: Cream arched service shelter with teal doorway lining and a clearly parted seam along one upper side.
items.distinction: Same shelter retained through repair, heating, occupancy and insulation.

items.name: Bedding
items.depiction: Rolled ivory sleeping bag with teal lining and a folded soft blanket tucked beneath charcoal straps.
items.distinction: Soft bedding alone without a bed frame.

items.name: Soup pouch
items.depiction: Sealed flexible cream food pouch with a restrained warm ochre soup-bowl motif and folded top seam.
items.distinction: Unheated food pouch, distinct from metal flask.

items.name: Insulated flask
items.depiction: Tall cylindrical brushed-metal insulated food flask with teal cap and a closed lid.
items.distinction: Reusable flask before meal is added.

items.name: Folding bed
items.depiction: Low open cream folding camp bed with taut charcoal fabric and crossed metal legs.
items.distinction: Empty bed without bedding.

items.name: Sealed refuge
items.depiction: Same cream service shelter with the torn seam repaired by an ivory patch and neat teal seam tape.
items.distinction: Physical repair is visible; no heater or bedding inside yet.

items.name: Warm refuge
items.depiction: Same repaired shelter with a warm interior glow and the orange-grille heater visible safely inside its doorway.
items.distinction: Heating appears through the doorway while the exterior silhouette remains unchanged.

items.name: Prepared bed
items.depiction: Same folding camp bed made up with ivory bedding, teal blanket and a small pillow.
items.distinction: Bed and bedding assembled together.

items.name: Prepared refuge
items.depiction: Same repaired warm shelter with a made-up camp bed visible through its broad doorway.
items.distinction: Ready for people; no occupants or meal flask yet.

items.name: Warm soup
items.depiction: Same cream soup pouch opened at its top, a little warm soup visible and a subtle upward wisp.
items.distinction: Warm prepared food remains in its original pouch.

items.name: Hot meal flask
items.depiction: Same teal-capped insulated flask with lid opened beside it and warm soup visible inside the broad mouth.
items.distinction: Contents and open lid distinguish it from the empty insulated flask.

items.name: Occupied refuge
items.depiction: Same warm prepared shelter, with two small resting crew figures visible inside near the made-up bed.
items.distinction: People are occupants within the scene, never separate inventory objects.

items.name: Provisioned refuge
items.depiction: Same occupied warm shelter with an open meal flask and simple cups visible on a low interior surface.
items.distinction: Food and habitation remain visible together.

items.name: Bench legs
items.depiction: Pair of folded cream metal trestle legs with charcoal hinges and rubber feet.
items.distinction: Legs alone without a worktop.

items.name: Worktop
items.depiction: Broad flat pale composite worktop with teal edge, visible underside mounting rail and rounded corners.
items.distinction: Loose top without legs or lamp.

items.name: Lamp bracket
items.depiction: Articulated cream metal worklight arm with a teal clamp at one end and lamp mounting cup at the other.
items.distinction: Empty bracket, not a complete lamp.

items.name: Message camera
items.depiction: Cream message-video camera with cobalt grip, prominent lens and small flip-out screen showing a paired-person outline.
items.distinction: Video-message camera distinguished from field camera by flip-out screen.

items.name: Antenna stand
items.depiction: Three-legged metal stand with telescoping cream pole and empty antenna mounting plate.
items.distinction: Empty communications support, no dish or radio.

items.name: Workbench
items.depiction: Broad pale worktop mounted on cream trestle legs, teal edge and empty top surface.
items.distinction: Unlit working table before a lamp is mounted.

items.name: Bench lamp
items.depiction: Warm round worklight fitted to its articulated cream bracket and teal worktop clamp.
items.distinction: Lamp and clamp assembled, without the table.

items.name: Crew message
items.depiction: Small physical video display showing two crew members in the refuge, with a discreet audio waveform beneath the picture.
items.distinction: Recorded message on a screen rather than printed portrait.

items.name: Message home
items.depiction: Same crew video display beside a small radio-transmission receipt strip with paired send-and-receive marks.
items.distinction: Transmission acknowledgment adds context without implying a new crew photograph.

items.name: Sled padding
items.depiction: Thick folded charcoal cargo padding with ivory quilted lining and a broad flexible strap.
items.distinction: Soft protective material rather than insulating clothing.

items.name: Picture roll
items.depiction: Partly unrolled ivory photo-paper roll showing a small colourful family picture at its exposed end.
items.distinction: Personal picture roll rather than blank thermal blanket.

items.name: Padded sling
items.depiction: Brick-red recovery rope threaded securely around a broad charcoal padded cargo sling.
items.distinction: Rope and protective padding visible as one lifting assembly.

items.name: Recovered mess crate
items.depiction: Large cream cargo crate with teal corner guards and a folded table structure visible under its open lid.
items.distinction: Recovered packed furniture, before unfolding.

items.name: Mess table
items.depiction: Simple cream folding mess table with charcoal crossed legs and a plain pale top.
items.distinction: Stable table shape retained in Personal table and Shared supper.

items.name: Personal table
items.depiction: Same folding mess table with a small framed family picture and a neatly laid teal cloth at the far edge.
items.distinction: Personal photograph visibly added without filling the working surface.

items.name: Shared supper
items.depiction: Same personal mess table with the small family picture, open warm meal flask and a few simple cups and bowls.
items.distinction: A meal arrangement, not an unrelated domestic dining table.

items.name: Crew portrait
items.depiction: Printed photograph with a narrow ivory border showing several crew members gathered around their camp supper table.
items.distinction: Printed group portrait distinct from video-message display.

items.name: Wall sample
items.depiction: Rectangular cream wall test panel standing in a small metal support, one cut edge showing its structure.
items.distinction: Bare test specimen before wrapping.

items.name: Temperature logger
items.depiction: Compact cobalt-edged temperature logger with a probe lead and a small clear numerical screen.
items.distinction: Measuring instrument rather than the recorded test result.

items.name: Thermal blanket
items.depiction: Broad folded quilted silver insulating sheet with teal edging, different from the small fabric swatch.
items.distinction: Full-size covering to be cut and fitted.

items.name: Clip frame
items.depiction: Open rectangular cream mounting frame with four teal spring clips and no central panel.
items.distinction: Empty fastening frame, not a wall specimen.

items.name: Measured wall template
items.depiction: Stiff ivory rectangular pattern sheet with a clear wall outline, corner cutouts and visible measurement ticks.
items.distinction: Physical fitting template rather than measured temperature record.

items.name: Insulation swatch
items.depiction: Small square cut section of quilted silver insulation with its ivory layered edge visible.
items.distinction: Small test swatch rather than the full thermal blanket.

items.name: Bare: 20 → 8°C
items.depiction: Cobalt-edged test record card with a bare wall specimen thumbnail and a descending blue trace ending visibly lower; leave precise reading to the item name.
items.distinction: Bare-sample result, not a claim about the whole refuge temperature.

items.name: Insulated wall sample
items.depiction: Same wall test panel wrapped in quilted silver insulation, with one cream edge and its metal support still visible.
items.distinction: Wrapped version of the same physical specimen.

items.name: Wrapped: 20 → 16°C
items.depiction: Matching test record card with a wrapped specimen thumbnail and a shallow descending teal trace ending higher than the bare test.
items.distinction: Wrapped-sample result; same chart scale as the bare record.

items.name: Wrapping slows cooling
items.depiction: Physical comparison board carrying the two matching wall-test charts side by side, a steep blue decline and a shallower teal decline.
items.distinction: Comparison of matched tests, not certification of complete insulation performance.

items.name: Fitted blanket
items.depiction: Quilted silver blanket cut to the measured wall shape, with neat corner notches and teal finished edges.
items.distinction: Shaped covering before installation in its clip frame.

items.name: Thermal screen
items.depiction: Shaped quilted silver insulation held taut inside its cream rectangular clip frame, teal clips clearly visible.
items.distinction: Complete framed covering rather than loose cloth.

items.name: Insulated refuge
items.depiction: Same occupied provisioned service shelter with a broad quilted silver thermal screen fitted to its exposed sidewall.
items.distinction: Preserve visible doorway, people and meal from the earlier refuge.

items.name: Return hose
items.depiction: Thick flexible charcoal circulation hose curved into a loose U with teal locking connectors at both ends.
items.distinction: Fluid hose wider than electrical cable, with matching sealed fittings.

items.name: Ice melter
items.depiction: Cream enclosed ice-processing vessel on a stout base, small top hatch and a clear side inspection window.
items.distinction: Enclosed melter before portable heater connection.

items.name: Treatment skid
items.depiction: Low cream processing skid with two vertical filter cylinders, teal pipework and a guarded pump enclosure.
items.distinction: Multi-stage treatment appliance rather than simple portable water filter.

items.name: Monitored tank
items.depiction: Upright cream tank with a narrow level window, cobalt monitor and inlet/outlet connections, visibly empty.
items.distinction: Same tank used for Water reserve.

items.name: Circulation pump
items.depiction: Compact metal circulation pump with teal motor housing, two large hose couplings and short supporting feet.
items.distinction: Pump alone before return hose forms a loop.

items.name: Heated melter
items.depiction: Same enclosed melter connected to the cream orange-grille electric heater through a short guarded service lead.
items.distinction: Heater connection visibly added.

items.name: Collected water
items.depiction: Large clear processing vessel containing slightly cloudy meltwater, cream handle and teal service coupling.
items.distinction: Process collection vessel, distinct from the small drinking-water container.

items.name: Water reserve
items.depiction: Same monitored cream tank with a visible blue-grey water level in its side window and active small monitor.
items.distinction: Filled tank, not a second shape of storage vessel.

items.name: Process water
items.depiction: Same handled processing vessel with clear water and teal service coupling, small equipment-water marking without readable text.
items.distinction: Treatment history requires ordinary context; do not imply drinking water.

items.name: Dry water loop
items.depiction: Teal circulation pump joined to a curved charcoal return hose, with transparent inspection section visibly empty.
items.distinction: Complete loop before priming.

items.name: Primed water loop
items.depiction: Same pump-and-hose loop with water visibly filling its transparent inspection section and no air gap.
items.distinction: Retain loop geometry; visible water establishes priming.

items.name: Camp water system
items.depiction: Connected monitored tank and circulation-pump loop, teal hoses linking the components into one compact working assembly.
items.distinction: Tank and primed loop both visible; process supply for growing equipment.

items.name: Greenhouse with torn seam
items.depiction: Small cream-framed transparent greenhouse shell with a parted seam in one clear wall and empty interior floor.
items.distinction: Same greenhouse shell as the compound base, with visible repair need.

items.name: Prepared substrate

items.name: Weather station
items.depiction: Cream field weather mast with wind vane and sensor pods, empty logger mounting bracket and solar-power attachment.
items.distinction: Mast and vane are already assembled; recorder and solar supply are fitted later.

items.name: Relay
items.depiction: Repaired cream relay transceiver on a stout mounting base, cobalt corner guards and empty antenna and power connections.
items.distinction: Fuse repair is complete while antenna and powerpack remain absent.

items.name: Crawler
items.depiction: Cream tracked expedition crawler with mustard panels, intact enclosed cabin, repaired drive panel and empty external sample-carrier mount.
items.distinction: Base repaired vehicle retains original silhouette; wheel, carrier and route fittings remain individually visible.

items.name: Lit workbench
items.depiction: Cream trestle workbench with pale top, teal edge and warm articulated lamp attached at the back corner; clear mounting rails on the empty top.
items.distinction: Workbench and lamp are complete; guarded machine must be absent before fitting.

items.name: Greenhouse
items.depiction: Repaired cream-framed transparent greenhouse with clear open front, teal seam repair and visibly empty bed, light, fan and diffuser mount positions.
items.distinction: Base shell remains intact beneath independent cultivation equipment layers.

items.name: Scout
items.depiction: Cream Mars scout airframe with delicate landing legs, camera pod and two stacked long counter-rotating black rotor assemblies, empty battery cradle.
items.distinction: Rotors are assembled; battery remains a separate fitted layer.

items.name: Two-cell comparison case
items.depiction: Open cream and cobalt specimen case with two clearly separated padded compartments, one broad flat ripple-impression space and one small gravel recess.
items.distinction: Keep specimens visibly separate; empty base has no embedded sample art.

items.name: Depot hauler
items.depiction: Low cream and mustard powered cargo hauler chassis on thick wheels, with empty controller recess and bare upper platform mounts.
items.distinction: Controller and cargo deck are independent fitted parts.

items.name: Oxygen plant
items.depiction: Cream processing stack joined to its cobalt-faced controller, sturdy base and a conspicuously empty intake coupling.
items.distinction: Processing stack and controller already joined; filtered intake is added independently.

items.name: Ascent cabin
items.depiction: Cream ascent cabin with repaired dark hatch gasket and broad open view into its empty interior; mounting sites for docking ring, oxygen module, console and seat remain exposed.
items.distinction: Preserve repaired pressure hull while all four required flight fittings are absent.

items.name: Return capsule
items.depiction: Open compact cream return capsule with cobalt structural frame, separated specimen recesses and flat archive pockets, empty exterior shock-mount attachment.
items.distinction: Six independent cargo and mount layers must remain visible without merging physical samples and their records.
